# tests/fixtures/

Small files tests load instead of the game's own: `art/` holds tiny figures, a manifest, bounds, and a portrait for `tests/ui/test_art_loading.gd`.

## Folders

| Folder | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `art/` | Art fixtures for `tests/ui/test_art_loading.gd`: a PNG beside an SVG of the same name, a 4x figure and a scale-2 boss with a manifest and bounds, apex and specialization figures for the fallbacks, and a portrait. |
